notes: Statistics retained as printed. Original and replication tests extracted independently. No metric conversion. Original uses directional tests. Replication methods confound presentation interval with recall delay (0.5 sec/word plus immediate cue versus 5 sec/word plus 10-second delay), and describe analysis as list recall, whereas original analyzes individual-item recall. Extracted the explicitly named corresponding factorial test; retain methodological discrepancy.
